title: Durable agent execution patterns — recommended smallest pattern (Queues + Durable Objects)
description: Comparative benchmark of Cloudflare Workflows, Queues+DO, Temporal, Inngest, Trigger.dev across checkpoints, retries, idempotency, cancellation, outbox, DLQ; includes smallest recommended architecture and next steps.

durable_matrix.workflows: Step-level checkpoints automatically persisted per workflow step
durable_matrix.queues_plus_do: Message-level checkpoints + DO persisted state; manual checkpointing achievable
durable_matrix.temporal: Full workflow history with deterministic replay — richest checkpointing
durable_matrix.inngest: Step checkpointing; good for functions-based flows
durable_matrix.evidence: Workflows docs; Queues docs; Temporal docs

durable_matrix.workflows: Per-step retries; no DLQ (workflow instance error view)
durable_matrix.queues_plus_do: At-least-once queue with configurable DLQ; individual acking avoids batch replays
durable_matrix.temporal: Per-activity retries with heartbeat/timeout semantics; admin tooling for failed workflows
durable_matrix.triggerdev: Configurable retries + idempotency keys; failed runs visible in dashboard
durable_matrix.evidence: Queues batching/retries; Workflows retry docs; Temporal activity timeouts

durable_matrix.workflows: Author must implement idempotency in steps
durable_matrix.queues_plus_do: Use DO single-threaded semantics + stored idempotency keys; recommended pattern
durable_matrix.temporal: Use heartbeats + external DB for idempotency patterns
durable_matrix.evidence: Queues + DO examples; Inngest idempotency; Trigger.dev idempotency

durable_matrix.workflows: Cancel/workflow termination APIs; no activity heartbeat primitive
durable_matrix.queues_plus_do: No built-in heartbeat; implement chunking/ping messages or DO lease pattern
durable_matrix.inngest: No Temporal-style heartbeat; chunk into steps
durable_matrix.triggerdev: Cancel run API; no heartbeat primitive

durable_matrix.workflows: No native outbox, implement with external store
durable_matrix.queues_plus_do: Natural fit: DO outbox + per-message ack + DLQ
durable_matrix.temporal: Strong patterns available via activities + durable history
durable_matrix.inngest: Outbox as functions with idempotency key; needs storage

durable_matrix.queues_plus_do: Low-medium (Cloudflare native primitives), easy for single-user agent
durable_matrix.evidence: docs: Workflows, Queues, Temporal, Inngest, Trigger.dev

durable_incidents.notes: Workflows or Queues+DO both workable; Workflows lower-code if steps short.
Temporal provides native heartbeats; do not attempt inside Workflows single-step timeouts.
Queues + DO (outbox pattern) provides explicit ack and DLQ; implement idempotency keys.
Workflows reduces code; Queues+DO is lightweight to implement and stays Cloudflare-native.

durable_evidence.note: At-least-once delivery, per-message ack, DLQ examples.

durable_evidence.source: Cloudflare Durable Objects — Error handling guidance
durable_evidence.note: DO state, .retryable/.overloaded flags and single-threaded semantics.
Activity heartbeats and rich failure model.

props.title: Durable agent execution patterns — recommended smallest pattern

props.content: This brief compares five durable execution approaches for agent workloads (Cloudflare Workflows, Queues+Durable Objects, Temporal, Inngest, Trigger.dev) across the requested dimensions and produces a smallest-viable recommendation for a one-user Cloudflare-hosted personal agent: Cloudflare Queues + Durable Objects (producer -> Queue consumer Worker -> per-agent DO for idempotency/outbox). Evidence and tradeoffs are cited.

props.caption: Which tool solves which capabilities (OK / needs-glue / heavy)

props.code:
flowchart LR
  User[User/request] --> Producer[Producer Worker]
  Producer -->|enqueue| CFQueue[Cloudflare Queue]
  Consumer[Consumer Worker] -->|pull batch| CFQueue
  Consumer --> DO[Per-user Durable Object]
  DO -->|persist idempotency/outbox| DO
  DO -->|call| ExternalAPI[LLM / Telegram / Webhook]
  ExternalAPI -->|2xx ack| DO
props.caption: Smallest recommended architecture: Producer enqueues messages, Consumer checks DO for idempotency/outbox, calls external APIs, ack per-message, DLQ on retries exhausted.

items.note: Producer + Queue consumer Worker + per-agent DO for idempotency and outbox (ack per message).
Add DLQ persistence, per-message retry policies, monitoring metrics and backoff circuit-breakers in DO.
If features like activity heartbeats or complex compensation needed, evaluate Temporal or hosted Inngest/Trigger.dev.
